authority_rule: Sources justify material choices, monitoring mechanisms and required tests. Published performance is not transferred numerically unless explicitly identified as a declared low-authority input.

sources.title: Vacuum Vessel
sources.use: Supports a double-walled steel vessel with cooling, in-wall shielding and safety-boundary functions.
sources.limit: ITER geometry, loads and materials are not a stellarator reactor qualification.

sources.title: Ensuring leak test sensitivity
sources.use: Supports monitored interspace and helium leak testing of double-wall vessel sectors.
sources.limit: Does not establish the v0.8 detection threshold or sector isolation time.

sources.title: Positioned at the vacuum boundary
sources.use: Supports double-seal feedthroughs with a monitored interspace as defense in depth.
sources.limit: Final v0.8 feedthrough count and qualification remain open.

sources.title: Integrity assessment of Tokamak-type fusion reactor First Wall and Blanket structures
sources.use: Supports explicit plastic strain, creep, radiation and lifetime analysis for RAFM first-wall structures.
sources.limit: Tokamak FNSF results and reported lifetime are not transferred to SFR-3.

sources.title: Transient multiphysics modeling of the electromagnetic loads on the first wall during plasma disruptions
sources.use: Supports coupled electromagnetic and structural analysis rather than pressure-only wall logic.
sources.limit: The v0.8 one-dimensional screen cannot reproduce this authority.

sources.title: ITER Blanket
sources.use: Supports actively cooled blanket modules and tungsten first-wall relevance.
sources.limit: ITER water cooling is not selected as the v0.8 integrated PbLi reference.

sources.title: Enhanced thermal fatigue resistance of W/Cu divertor components via serrated interface design
sources.use: Supports retaining engineered W/Cu interfaces as a comparison branch.
sources.limit: Divertor results do not qualify a first-wall blanket system.

sources.title: Improving interfacial bonding and properties of W/W-Cu FGM/CuCrZr joints
sources.use: Supports the thermally favorable W-Cu-CuCrZr comparison stack and its joining challenge.
sources.limit: The joint is not qualified for full fusion-neutron reactor service.

sources.title: Mitigated Dissimilar Mass Transfer with Aluminized RAFM Steels in Flowing PbLi at 650 C
sources.use: Supports retaining RAFM, coating and SiC/PbLi compatibility as an experimental qualification path.
sources.limit: Loop exposures do not close reactor corrosion, MHD or lifetime.

sources.title: All-metal packaged temperature compensation fiber optic Fabry-Perot strain sensor for high-temperature liquid metal environments
sources.use: Supports an all-metal temperature-compensated strain-sensing research candidate near liquid-metal systems.
sources.limit: Demonstration to 500 C is not fusion-neutron qualification.

sources.title: Assessment of Neutron Radiation Effects on the Fiber Optics Current Sensor Performance During JET DTE2
sources.use: Supports explicit neutron-effects testing for optical current and magnetic instrumentation.
sources.limit: JET campaign exposure is not a reactor lifetime guarantee.

sources.title: Electric field-assisted embedding of fiber optic sensors in structural materials for structural health monitoring
sources.use: Supports studying stainless or nickel encapsulation of optical fibers for SHM.
sources.limit: Embedding and bonding performance under fusion irradiation remain unproven.

explicit_non_transfers: No ITER vessel dimension or pressure is copied into the stellarator geometry.
No published wall lifetime is assigned to the selected stack.
No sensor probability of detection is invented.
No thermal screen result is converted into confinement or ignition credit.
